brief.headline: Push Universal Starch to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG price — we're overpaying ₹14.26 L/year for the same Dextrose.

priceAsk.summary: Ask Universal Starch to match ₹66.48/KG, the price Sayaji Industries gives us for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP.
priceAsk.basis: We already buy identical Dextrose Anhydrous IP from Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG — Universal charges us ₹75.51/KG, a 13.6% premium. The open market shows Anhydrous Dextrose typically sells at ₹66–73/kg, so ₹66.48 sits right in the fair band. No reason to pay more.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed.

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch publishes no financials, so we can't see how tight their cash is or how healthy they are. That said, our ₹59.65 L annual spend is real business, and we have five credible backup makers lined up — including Sayaji, who already delivers at ₹66.48/KG. The open market and our own purchase history both say ₹66–73/kg is normal, so pushing to Sayaji's price is grounded and safe. Since we can't lean on their balance sheet, we lean on our data and our alternatives.

evidence.point: We pay Universal ₹75.51/KG but pay Sayaji only ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP.
evidence.figure: ourAvgPrice: ₹75.51/KG; bestPriceWePay: ₹66.48/KG; bestVendor: Sayaji Industries Limited

evidence.point: The gap costs us an extra ₹14.26 L every year.
Open-market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target ₹66.48 sits in the fair zone.
evidence.figure: marketAsk askBand: ₹60–81/kg; typical: ₹66–73/kg; verdict: MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)

evidence.point: India's export unit value for Dextrose is ₹42.95/kg — well below what we pay, showing room for lower pricing.
Our annual spend with Universal is ₹59.65 L — material enough to earn their best price.

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited (already approved)
alternates.why: Already supplies us Dextrose Anhydrous IP at ₹66.48/KG — proven, qualified and 13.6% cheaper than Universal.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller; makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching.

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji.

risks: Universal publishes no financials — we can't gauge their health or how hard to push without tipping them into trouble; keep the tone firm but collaborative.
If Universal won't move on price, be ready to shift more volume to Sayaji (₹66.48/KG) or bring in Tirupati/Gulshan as a second source — but qualify those two first (IP monograph CoA).
Dextrose is a commodity excipient with many makers — don't get locked in; use the five backups to keep pressure on price every cycle.

Our ₹59.65 L spend is meaningful but not huge to a regional starch player; they may dig in if margin is already thin — have Sayaji's ₹66.48 price and the market band (₹66–73) ready to show it's fair, not a squeeze.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹75.51 a kilo when Sayaji delivers the same Dextrose at ₹66.48 — let's talk about bringing your price in line.
